title: Be a registered land surveyor
what: Carry on business as a land surveyor, or survey land, only as a registered land surveyor (or under one's supervision).

sources.title: Surveyors Act 2002 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is not a registered land surveyor must not carry on business or hold himself or herself out as a land surveyor or registered land surveyor

sources.title: Surveyors Act 2002 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is not a registered land surveyor, or acting under the supervision of a registered land surveyor, must not survey land

sources.title: Surveyors Act 2002 (Tas)
